entries.prompt: Create a heartwarming, highly photorealistic overhead photograph of a handwritten letter to God, lovingly written by an innocent 6-year-old child. The letter should look genuinely handmade, with imperfect childhood handwriting, playful doodles, colorful pencil drawings, and a touching sense of innocence, kindness, and hope.  The letter must contain this exact passage:  Dear God,  Hi God! How are you? I hope you are happy up there.  I have a little wish for you. Please keep all the people in the world healthy, safe, and happy.  Please help the sick people get better. Give everyone food, water, and a nice home to sleep in.  Please take care of all the animals too. The big elephants, tiny ants, little birds, puppies, kittens, and everyone else.  Please don't let any animal be hungry or sad. They are our friends too!  Please keep the trees green, the flowers smiling, and the rivers clean. Please make our Earth happy and beautiful.  And God, please help everyone love each other and be kind. I want the whole world to smile!  Thank you for listening to me. I love you, God!  Love, Your little friend ❤️  HANDWRITING STYLE:  Render every word in authentic, innocent handwriting resembling that of a real 6-year-old child learning to write.  Use a simple graphite pencil with slightly uneven pressure, occasional darker strokes, shaky letter shapes, irregular spacing, inconsistent letter heights, and gently wandering baselines.  Some letters should be unusually large while others are small. A few words may lean slightly upward or downward, creating the charming imperfection of genuine childhood handwriting.  Avoid elegant cursive, calligraphy, professional typography, or computer-generated fonts.  The writing should feel spontaneous, slightly clumsy, and emotionally sincere, as though a little child carefully wrote every word with love.  Include a few faint pencil eraser marks, tiny smudges, and naturally imperfect handwriting details while keeping every word clearly legible.  CHILDLIKE DOODLES AND DRAWINGS:  Surround the letter with adorable, imperfect drawings made using colored pencils and wax crayons.  Include: - A smiling yellow sun with uneven rays in the upper corner. - Fluffy blue clouds with happy faces. - A colorful, slightly crooked rainbow. - A small Earth with a smiling face, blue oceans, and green land. - Simple stick-figure children holding hands. - A tiny elephant, a puppy, a kitten, and two little birds. - Small green trees, colorful flowers, butterflies, and hearts. - A few stars scattered randomly around the page. - Tiny paw prints near the bottom.  All drawings must look genuinely created by a 6-year-old, with uneven outlines, simple shapes, imperfect coloring, scribbled textures, and playful proportions.  Do not make the illustrations professionally polished or digitally perfect.  PAPER AND COMPOSITION:  Place the letter on a single sheet of slightly crumpled, off-white notebook paper with faint horizontal guidelines.  The page should have naturally curled corners, subtle wrinkles, and realistic paper fibers.  Keep the handwriting in the center of the page, with colorful doodles scattered around the margins and corners without covering any words.  The entire letter must fit comfortably on one page, with balanced spacing and sufficient room for the drawings.  Arrange a few short colored pencils, a slightly worn pencil, a pink eraser, and two small wax crayons casually beside the paper.  LIGHTING AND ATMOSPHERE:  Use soft, warm morning sunlight entering from a nearby window, creating gentle natural shadows across the paper.  The background should be a simple wooden study table, suggesting the quiet, innocent world of a young child.  The overall mood should feel pure, peaceful, emotional, hopeful, and deeply touching.  It should look like a real little child sat at a table and wrote a heartfelt prayer asking God to protect every human, animal, plant, and living thing on Earth.  PHOTOREALISM REQUIREMENTS:  Capture realistic pencil graphite texture, uneven crayon marks, subtle paper grain, gentle smudges, naturally imperfect drawings, and authentic childhood penmanship.  Preserve the exact wording, capitalization, punctuation, paragraph breaks, and sequence of every line.  Do not omit, repeat, distort, crop, or replace any words.  Avoid gibberish, artificial lettering, excessive decoration, or overlapping text.  The final image should resemble a precious childhood letter that a parent would lovingly preserve for years.  Camera angle: Directly overhead, flat-lay composition.  Aspect ratio: Portrait 3:4.  Style: Ultra-photorealistic, nostalgic childhood stationery photography, soft natural light, warm gentle colors

entries.prompt:
Aspect ratio 2:3, native 4K. A flat, straight-on, perfectly lit high-resolution scan of an authentic 1890s American letterpress broadside poster, printed in red, black, and metallic gold ink on aged cream paper with subtle fiber texture, faint fold creases, slight ink spread, and tiny foxing spots. The poster is packed edge to edge with typography in the classic Victorian circus style: every line in a different wood type face, including bold slab serifs, tall condensed gothics, ornate Tuscan letters, outlined and shadowed display type, and elegant copperplate script. Ornamental borders of filigree, stars, and pointing hands frame everything. Fine engraved illustrations decorate the poster: a pair of turntables with lightning bolts between them, a violin wreathed in laurels, a woman with rays of color bursting from her eyes, a giant brass horn speaker, and mechanical singing automatons. All of the following text must appear exactly as written, correctly spelled, in this order from top to bottom:

Arched across the top: "BY POPULAR DEMAND! ONE NIGHT ONLY!"
Huge headline: "PLASM0'S"
Giant main title on two lines: "GRAND ELECTRO-ACOUSTICAL" / "SPECTACULAR"
Subtitle in script: "A Marvel of Modern Sound & Science, Never Before Witnessed by Mortal Ears!"
Ribbon banner: "SATURDAY, DECEMBER 12th · DOORS AT 9 O'CLOCK · THE CRYSTAL PAVILION, CHICAGO"
Section heading: "FEATURING"
Two columns of six numbered acts, each with a bold name and a smaller description beneath:
"1. THE THUNDERING TURNTABLES" / "Two Direct-Drive Engines Spinning in Perfect Synchrony!"
"2. THE PHANTOM VIOLIN" / "Fifteen Years of Classical Mastery Summoned from Thin Air!"
"3. MADAME KROMESTHESIA" / "She Sees Every Note in Living Color!"
"4. THE BINAURAL WHISPERER" / "Sounds That Travel from One Ear to the Other!"
"5. THE INCREDIBLE BASS CANNON" / "Felt in the Chest Before It Is Heard by the Ear!"
"6. THE AUTOMATON CHOIR" / "Twelve Mechanical Voices in Perfect Harmony!"
Circular gold medallion seal: "ADMISSION 50¢ · LADIES FREE BEFORE TEN"
Two testimonial quotes in italic: "I have never danced so vigorously in all my life." - The Duchess of Wicker Park / "My hat flew clean off my head." - A Gentleman of Logan Square
Boxed panel titled "RULES OF THE HOUSE": "1. No Fainting Upon the Dance Floor." "2. Hats Must Be Removed During the Drop." "3. Requests Will Be Politely Ignored." "4. Management Is Not Responsible for Lost Shoes, Spirits, or Sense of Time."
Tiny fine print along the bottom edge: "Printed by the Midwestern Steam Press Co., Chicago, 1893. All Sounds Guaranteed Genuine. The Management Reserves the Right to Increase the Volume Without Notice. Refunds Issued Only in the Event of Total Silence."

Every letter crisp, sharp, and legible at full size, with authentic letterpress character.

entries.prompt:
01/
Create a dynamic 2D animated illustration of a young male psychic with messy spiky dark navy hair, a youthful rounded face, large circular glowing white eyes, subtly flushed cheeks, and a quiet, hypnotic expression. He wears a loose dark navy high-collar school uniform jacket with three small brass buttons. Medium shot, facing the viewer directly, both arms extended toward the camera in a dramatic psychic power gesture. His left hand reaches forward from the upper left, fingers loosely curled downward, while his right hand extends from the lower right, palm partially open with fingers dynamically spread. Strong but controlled wide-angle foreshortening, hands larger than natural perspective but anatomically readable, face clearly visible between them. Dynamic asymmetrical composition, expressive hand gestures, natural arm connections, clear silhouette. Thin, irregular pale cyan electric arcs twist between his fingers and around his shoulders, accompanied by a few small flat pale yellow graphic impact marks. The supernatural effects are minimal, carefully spaced, and entirely hand-drawn, integrated naturally into the illustration. Render in a refined hand-drawn 2D animated style with the exact visual language of traditional cel-shaded animation. Clean, thin, confident dark navy ink outlines with subtle hand-drawn irregularities, delicate line-weight variation, and selectively broken contours. Large flat color regions, precise two-tone cel shading, sharply defined angular shadow shapes, simplified graphic lighting, and absolutely minimal gradients. Sparse short dry-brush hatching, fine parallel pencil strokes, and subtle scratch-like texture marks selectively applied along clothing folds, hair, shadow boundaries, and background surfaces. Smooth matte flat colors with restrained hand-painted imperfections, not rough painterly rendering. Strictly controlled cool monochromatic blue color palette: cornflower blue, dusty cobalt, muted periwinkle, slate blue, desaturated cyan, and deep navy, with pale warm peach skin tones and tiny muted golden accents. Soft blue ambient lighting unifies the character, hands, clothing, and surrounding effects. Background consists of a simple flat dusty blue interior wall with a few understated geometric architectural lines, leaving generous negative space. Harmonious low-saturation colors, elegant tonal separation, cohesive atmospheric blue color grading. Authentic hand-drawn 2D animation keyframe aesthetic, graphic clarity, expressive character design, precise contour drawing, natural imperfect linework, and restrained illustrative textures.

02/
Create a stylized 2D Western animated illustration of a mysterious young male hacker sitting at a vintage desktop computer in a cramped retro computer room. He has short black hair with a sharp white fringe, an angular pale face, a large expressive side-profile eye, an oversized dark jacket with geometric markings, and long slender fingers typing on a chunky mechanical keyboard. Extreme low-angle fisheye perspective from desk level, oversized hands dominating the foreground, bulky CRT monitor on the left, curved tiled ceiling, scattered wall posters, and strong architectural depth. Preserve the character's focused typing pose, distinctive facial expression, dramatic camera angle, and coherent spatial arrangement. Render in a sophisticated stylized Western 2D animation aesthetic with delicate hand-drawn comic illustration techniques and refined graphic character design. Thin, confident dark navy ink outlines with subtle organic irregularities, natural line-weight variation, expressive flowing contours, selectively broken edges, and precise facial linework. Simplified geometric anatomy, exaggerated but believable proportions, angular character construction, and distinctive silhouettes. Large uninterrupted flat color regions, clean two-tone cel shading, sharply defined angular shadow blocks, simplified geometric highlights, minimal gradients, and carefully balanced graphic shapes. Subtle short pencil hatching, restrained dry-brush marks along selected edges, imperfect freehand contours, and crisp matte color fills. Sophisticated 2D animation keyframe aesthetics, cinematic spatial perspective, bold editorial illustration composition, expressive character acting, and elegant visual simplicity. Strictly use a cohesive cool blue color palette of cornflower blue, dusty cobalt, slate blue, muted periwinkle, powder blue, pale icy cyan, and deep navy, complemented by tiny muted golden-yellow accents. The ceiling and walls use layered desaturated blues, the CRT monitor displays a flat pale icy-blue screen, the character's clothing is deep navy with angular cobalt shadow planes, and the keyboard uses muted blue-gray tones. Soft cool blue ambient lighting unifies the entire composition, with small warm yellow details creating restrained visual contrast. Harmonious blue-on-blue color separation, strong tonal hierarchy, matte surfaces, and clean graphic lighting. Apply refined localized gradient halftone shading only within selected cel-shaded shadow regions, especially along the character's fingers, cheek shadows, jacket folds, and occasional architectural shadow boundaries. Use extremely fine, tightly arranged halftone microdots in colors matching the underlying shadows, gradually decreasing in size and opacity toward the illuminated areas. The halftone creates elegant soft tonal transitions within small, organically shaped shadow zones, naturally dissolving into clean flat colors. The pattern must be clearly recognizable as delicate traditional comic-print halftone shading at close inspection, never as large individual decorative circles. Keep all other surfaces perfectly clean and solid, without any global texture. Preserve strong cinematic depth through exaggerated fisheye perspective, overlapping graphic shapes, and precise architectural construction rather than realistic lighting gradients. entries.prompt: Aspect ratio 16:9, native 4K. Macro product photograph of an engraved banknote lying flat on a dark slate desk, shot straight down with soft raking studio light that reveals the raised intaglio ink texture. The note is from a fictional nation, "THE FEDERATION OF SOUND", printed in deep violet and burnished copper inks on cream security paper with visible embedded colored fibers. The note fills most of the frame. Design: intricate guilloche rosettes and spirograph lathe-work patterns in every corner and along the borders, made of thousands of interlocking hairlines; a large oval vignette on the left containing a finely engraved line-art portrait of an original allegorical figure, "Lady Harmony", a serene woman wearing a laurel crown and holding a violin bow, shaded entirely with parallel and crosshatched engraved lines in classic banknote portrait style; on the right, an engraved vignette of a grand concert hall with sound waves radiating from its dome. Text, all exactly as written and correctly spelled: across the top in ornate engraved serif capitals, "THE FEDERATION OF SOUND"; beneath it in smaller letters, "SOUND RESERVE NOTE"; large denomination numerals "100" in all four corners inside guilloche medallions; across the center, "ONE HUNDRED BEATS"; small line of text beneath, "THIS NOTE IS LEGAL TENDER ON ALL DANCE FLOORS, PUBLIC AND PRIVATE"; red serial numbers "PL 0042 1993 A" printed twice, upper right and lower left; "SERIES 2026" near the center; two handwritten-style signatures above the printed titles "Treasurer of Tempo" and "Secretary of Bass"; and a bold diagonal red overprint across the note reading "SPECIMEN". A continuous line of microprinting runs around the inner border, repeating the words "SOUND RESERVE" endlessly in tiny letters. Resting on the lower right corner of the note is a glass jeweler's loupe that magnifies a section of the border, revealing the microprinting clearly readable inside the lens along with the raised ink ridges and paper fibers. Extreme sharpness, true macro photography detail, shallow depth of field falling off softly at the far edges of the note.

An ultra-realistic high-fashion editorial photograph of a striking 28-year-old Japanese man with sharp facial features, a defined jawline, slightly messy medium-length black hair and narrow rectangular black sunglasses, sitting confidently on a rooftop terrace while playing chess.

He wears an oversized luxurious emerald-green faux-fur coat over a black silk shirt, tailored black trousers and a subtle silver chain necklace. His expression is calm, confident and slightly intimidating, looking directly toward the camera.

Camera composition: An extreme low-angle shot taken from the very edge of a chessboard, with the camera positioned only a few centimeters above the board's surface. The black-and-white chessboard dominates the entire bottom third of the frame, its squares appearing exceptionally large in the foreground and rapidly shrinking toward the seated man.

The man is centered in the composition, visible from approximately the knees upward, leaning slightly forward. His right arm extends directly toward the camera, with his hand dramatically enlarged by perspective. He is gripping the top of a polished ivory wooden king chess piece between his thumb and index finger, moving it toward an empty square near the camera. His other hand rests naturally near his knee. The chess pieces are physically accurate and positioned naturally on the board, with realistic contact shadows and detailed polished wooden surfaces.

Environment: An open urban rooftop with subtle concrete architectural details, low surrounding rooftops and an enormous vivid cyan-blue sky with a few soft, scattered white clouds. The bright sky occupies the upper half of the composition, creating strong visual contrast against the emerald-green coat.

Photography: Shot on a Sony A1 II with a 20mm wide-angle lens, camera placed at chessboard level, f/8, ISO 100, 1/1000s. Deep environmental perspective, exaggerated foreground scale, realistic optical distortion, crisp textures across the chessboard and subject. Bright natural midday sunlight, accurate skin tones, natural facial asymmetry, individual hair strands, detailed fabric and fur fibers, subtle imperfections and physically realistic shadows.

Authentic luxury fashion campaign photography, bold editorial framing, natural photographic color grading, exceptionally realistic skin texture, no artificial skin smoothing, no CGI appearance, no illustration, no plastic textures, no excessive cinematic effects.

entries.prompt: Create ONE horizontal 16:9 photorealistic cinematic action image with 4K-level detail. AAA survival-action game key art with the believable textures, lighting, and physical presence of a big-budget live-action film. One decisive frozen instant, not a montage.  REFERENCES Image 1 defines the adult heroine's identity and wardrobe. Preserve her exact face, hairstyle, hair colors, body proportions, outfit, footwear, and accessories.  Image 2 defines the giant zombie firefighter. Preserve his recognizable face, massive physique, pale weathered skin, damaged black helmet, worn dark firefighter uniform with faded yellow reflective bands, and heavy boots. He is approximately 2.4 meters tall, much larger than the heroine. Use an active combat pose instead of his reference pose.  Image 3 defines the location, architecture, weather, and lighting. Retain the yellow taxi on the left, abandoned bus in the right middle distance, ruined corner storefront with warm interior light, wet asphalt, brick buildings, fire escapes, and distant misty skyscrapers. Match its grounded photographic realism.  MAIN ACTION The heroine delivers a powerful straight kick into the firefighter zombie's chest, launching him backward toward the yellow taxi.  Capture the exact final instant of contact: her boot sole is still pressed against his chest while both of his boots have just lifted a short distance off the ground. This is one kick with one clearly visible contact point.  SCREEN POSITIONS Place the heroine in the RIGHT foreground, facing LEFT. Place the zombie in the LEFT foreground, facing RIGHT. The yellow taxi is behind the zombie, farther to the LEFT, directly along his backward trajectory. Leave a visible gap between his back and the vehicle. He has not hit the taxi yet.  HEROINE POSE Her left boot is firmly planted on the wet asphalt, supporting her weight, with the left knee slightly bent. Her right leg extends toward the left at chest height, its knee nearly straight but not hyperextended.  The sole of her right boot presses squarely into the center of the zombie's upper chest, below his collarbones. Show the boot in profile with unmistakable sole-to-chest contact. The boot must not penetrate his body.  Her hips drive into the kick while her torso leans slightly backward for balance. Her arms are bent naturally in a fighting guard, separated from her kicking leg. Her face is visible in three-quarter profile, eyes focused on the enemy, brows tense, jaw set with controlled effort.  Preserve the reference footwear exactly. Show a convincing weight-bearing connection between her planted boot and the pavement.  ZOMBIE REACTION His chest is driven backward toward the left. His upper torso recoils away from the boot, shoulders falling behind his hips, while his head tilts back slightly and his face remains recognizable.  Both feet have just left the asphalt by approximately 10–20 centimeters. His knees bend loosely and his heavy boots lag behind the movement of his torso. His arms fling outward with relaxed, separated fingers as he loses balance. He is being knocked backward, not jumping, running, or attacking.  Compress and crease the firefighter jacket at the boot's contact point. Loose jacket edges move with his recoil. His helmet remains on his head. Small displaced droplets hang beneath his lifted boots, with a visible shadow below him.  The heroine's supernatural strength explains the size difference. Convey it through posture and the enemy's recoil, without magical light or energy effects.  ENVIRONMENT AND CONTINUITY All taxi doors remain attached. No detached door, shield, or handheld weapon anywhere in the scene. Preserve existing wear and damage from Image 3, but do not show a new collision dent before the zombie reaches the taxi.  A small group of ordinary human-sized zombies approaches in the distant street. Their faces and civilian clothing are varied. No duplicate firefighter enemies. Keep background figures away from the silhouettes of the heroine's legs and the main impact.  CAMERA Medium-wide, nearly side-on view of the kick, camera around the heroine's waist height with a natural 35mm lens perspective. Both characters are shown completely, including all footwear and the space beneath the airborne zombie.  Keep the heroine's supporting leg, extended kicking leg, boot-to-chest contact, and zombie's backward lean clearly separated and readable. Avoid foreshortening along the kicking leg. Place the main action across the image from right to left.  Keep both faces and the impact sharp. Use modest background separation while preserving the recognizable environment. No extreme perspective, tilted horizon, or cropped limbs.  LIGHTING AND REALISM Cool overcast daylight and subtle warm light from the ruined storefront, matching Image 3. Realistic skin pores, damp hair, wet clothing, weathered canvas, cracked helmet finish, dirty reflective stripes, and chipped vehicle paint. Accurate pavement reflections and grounded contact shadows.  Restrained cinematic contrast, natural material colors, atmospheric depth between buildings. Minimal motion blur on peripheral droplets and loose fabric only. Crisp anatomy and readable action. The result should resemble a photographed stunt enhanced with convincing cinematic visual effects.
